info.title: Statamic App API
info.description:
JSON for single-page apps on Statamic, over Laravel Sanctum.

Session: fetch `/sanctum/csrf-cookie` once, then send the `XSRF-TOKEN` cookie back as `X-XSRF-TOKEN` with every write (axios does this with `withCredentials: true`). Tokens: `Authorization: Bearer <token>`.

Every error has the shape `{error: {code, message, field?, details?}}`. `code` is stable.

get.summary: What this API offers: active areas, the team header, the CSRF cookie path.

post.summary: Sign in with Statamic's login. Answers `two_factor: true` when a code is needed next.
Second step of a login with two-factor authentication: a code from the app or a recovery code.

get.summary: WebAuthn assertion options for a passkey login.

post.summary: Sign in with a passkey (the WebAuthn assertion).
Create an account through Statamic's registration and sign in. Fields of the user blueprint are accepted as well.
Sign out and end the session.
Mail a reset link through Statamic's password broker. Always the same answer, whether the address exists or not.
Set a new password with the token from the mail.

post.summary: Confirm with the password, the mailed code or a passkey assertion. Opens the elevated session.
Mail a confirmation code (accounts without a password).
